lcd_dim_on_battery.description: Whether to automatically dim the LCD when running on battery power.

auto_brightness.description: Enable automatic adjustment of LCD brightness based on ambient light sensor.

min_brightness.description: Minimum LCD brightness level (0–15). Set higher in bright environments.

max_brightness.description: Maximum LCD brightness level (0–15). Set lower to conserve battery.

low_battery_warning.description: Battery percentage at which a warning notification is shown.

low_battery_suspend.description: Battery percentage at which the system automatically suspends.

suspend_timeout.description: Seconds of inactivity before auto-suspend (0 to disable).

blank_timeout.description: Seconds of inactivity before the LCD blanks (0 to disable).

suspend_on_lid_close.description: Whether to suspend immediately when the laptop lid is closed (any power source).

suspend_on_lid_close_battery_only.description: If true, suspend only on lid-close when on battery (overrides suspend_on_lid_close when false).

power_policies.description: Custom power policies defining actions for specific events (e.g., charger plug/unplug, lid close). Each item maps a policy name to an action.

action.description: Command or built-in action to execute (e.g., 'suspend', 'blank', 'none')

debug.description: Enable verbose debugging output to system log for troubleshooting.

backlight_script.description: Optional path to a custom script that overrides default backlight control (e.g., for hardware-specific adjustment).
